{{Top|leg}}
'''Zeb''' was a [[Scout/Legends|scout]] and subscriber to, and commenter on, ''[[Cynabar's Droid Datalog]]''.<ref name="CFTD">''[[Cynabar's Fantastic Technology: Droids]]''</ref> In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], Zeb mentioned on the entry for the [[GV/3-series guardian droid]] that they owned one and employed it as a scouting assistant by adding [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]], tracking [[SkillWare]] and an [[automap]].<ref name="CDD">{{JournalCite|14|Cynabar's Droid Datalog (article series)}}</ref> In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], commenting on the entry for the [[F1 exploration droid]], Zeb revealed that they had worked with a number of F1s during early scouting missions. Unlike other scouts who disdained using droids for exploration, Zeb disagreed and tasked the units with perimeter security. A few months later, Zeb commented on the [[ASP-7 labor droid/Legends|ASP-7 labor droid]] entry, stating they were good workers, easy to modify, but not very intelligent. In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], Zeb commented on the entry for the [[Wanderer Scout Surveyor]]. Zeb used to use a Wanderer and while it was a capable droid, it didn't fit Zeb's preference for droids with more personality. Zeb tried to update its [[Personality matrix/Legends|personality matrix]], but found that the new protocols would be ignored. Several [[Standard month/Legends|months]] later, Zeb left a comment on the [[TS-Arach series Pest Control Droid]] entry. By hooking up an [[automap]] to the droid, Zeb found that it was extremely capable of scanning and mapping large areas, in additional to having detailed holos of the local wildlife.<ref name="CFTD" />
